name: 時刻の書式と外部の説明を調整する利用設定
prompt:
Use case: color-only correction for LH07-0108. Image 1 is the reviewed Japanese candidate and controls exact layout, content, typography, sizes, positions and states. Image 2 controls original radio anatomy. Image 3 verifies exact Japanese text and the accepted section rhythm. Image 4 controls the approved Lighthouse palette.

Keep Image 1 otherwise pixel-faithful. Change only the two selected radio indicators: replace the flat solid-green outlines and center dots with the exact forest-green gradient from the approved standard, #174C36 → #1F6444 → #2D8F5E. The gradient should be visibly present along the selected outer ring and center dot, contained within the original radio dimensions. Keep the unselected radio neutral gray.

Preserve the white 390×284 panel, exact strings, selected states, divider positions, muted footer, dark headings/body, gray examples, Meiryo typography, margins and section spacing. Do not move, scale, add, remove, recolor or redraw anything else. No background tint, card, toolbar, icon, extra action, glow or decorative accent. Keep the same aspect ratio and component scale.
reviewNotes: 390x284 actual-size review: exact Japanese copy and selected states preserved; source geometry and white surfaces retained; selected radio rings show forest-green gradient variation. Candidate-level visual review only.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。

references.observation: Best reviewed layout; current mismatch is flat solid-green selected radios.
